title: Canada › Canoe › Film In
intro: The film in (story/films/snowman.ts): the snowy park under the castle hotel, flags and lanterns, nobody about.

flags.text: Every big game starts with a song.
That's Lulu the loon! Nobody sings like Lulu.
She lives across the lake, by the glacier. Let's paddle!

script.text: Every big game starts with a song.

script.when: A loon calls, far across the water, and the mountains answer (a beat with no line). Maple's ears go up.
